simple.meaning: חַרְצֻבָּה (chartsubbâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a fetter ; figuratively, a pain.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חַרְצֻבָּה (H2784) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 73:4, with occurrences in Psalms, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חַרְצֻבָּה (H2784) in the Hebrew text.
